content.short: TropicalSwap is a community-driven DEX on Mantle Network offering token trading, staking, and yield farming powered by the native $PAPPLE token.
content.description: TropicalSwap is a decentralized exchange built on Mantle Network that combines standard AMM trading with a community-focused tokenomics model centered around its native $PAPPLE token. Users can swap tokens with low fees, provide liquidity to earn trading fee revenue, and stake $PAPPLE for additional yield rewards. TropicalSwap has cultivated a playful, community-first brand within the Mantle ecosystem and regularly runs campaigns and incentive programs to reward active community members.
